archetypes.name: prompt-scope
archetypes.rationale: Verify non-review background waits cannot still trigger reviewer-table output.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design prompt wording around immediate-background waits. Confirm Step 3 review and resume fences retain the compact reviewer table. Confirm Step 5c and Final summary require only plain breadcrumbs and do not invite stale Step 3 reviewer artifact reads outside the existing safety ban. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
